candidates.title: Indian national among two people killed in attack on Saudi Arabia’s airport, two Indians injured
candidates.excerpt: An Indian national was among two people killed, while two other Indian nationals were injured, in an attack on King Fahd International Airport in Saudi Arabia's Dammam on Wednesday, the Indian Embassy said on Thursday.

candidates.title: Sridhar Babu Urges Congress Cadres to Focus on Graduate Voter Registration
candidates.excerpt: The Minister said the cadres must take the registration of graduate voters as a matter of utmost prestige and it is the responsibility of leaders and party workers to ensure that every eligible graduate is registered as a voter

candidates.title: Diego Maradona Death Trial Verdict Set For December 22
candidates.excerpt: The verdict in the trial over the 2020 death of Argentine football legend Diego Maradona will be delivered on December 22, the court announced Thursday, after six months of hearings.

candidates.title: 'He put it back': Trump says Ukraine's Starlink restored, stays silent on Musk
candidates.excerpt: Ukraine depends heavily on Starlink for communications between military units, coordinating operations and receiving early warnings during Russian missile attacks. The satellite-based network also supports the use of drones, which Ukraine deploys both to strike Russian targets and to defend against incoming attacks. Disruptions to connectivity can therefore affect the military's ability to operate drones and respond to Russian assaults.

candidates.title: Govt plans colour-coded driving licence for Indians, foreigners
candidates.excerpt: Life insurance policies, too, would no longer be accepted as proof. Proposing sweeping changes to the driving licence (DL) regime under Motor Vehicles Rules, the road transport ministry Wednesday issued a draft notification to raise the pass mark for the online safe-driving tutorial assessment from the current 60% to 75%.

candidates.title: Don’t blindly follow foreign custody order: Supreme Court
candidates.excerpt: A bench of Justices J B Pardiwala and K V Viswanathan said cases already dealt with by foreign courts were coming before it time and again and their adjudication was not easy as they involved deeply emotional and sensitive issues. It added that the welfare of the child “must be understood in the widest sense, not by money or physical comfort alone”.

candidates.title: Hospitals ‘overcharging’ is a malpractice: Govt to Supreme Court
candidates.excerpt: In an affidavit filed in SC on the issue of capping prices of all medicines and medical consumables, chemicals and fertilisers ministry said that patients have a very low bargaining position with respect to hospitals, resulting in various malpractices. The affidavit noted the irony of India being home to companies making cheap drugs but patients here having to pay way above the manufacturing price, as well as patients being subjected to overcharging by hospitals.
